title: Cluster smoke: real three-role loop over two arithmetic transactions
objective: Produce two verified sums through the cluster. Transaction {{runId}}-a must use the flow_sum tool on [2,3] and submit the resulting value; transaction {{runId}}-b must use the flow_sum tool on [15,40] and submit the resulting value.

acceptance_criteria: The submitted result contains the number 5
The number came from a real flow_sum tool call in this session
